item.title: Staff Data Scientist - Product Growh - Intuit
item.description:
**Overview** ------------
The **Global Business Solutions Group (GBSG) Product Growth team** is dedicated to accelerating business outcomes through a data-driven, product-led approach to growth. We leverage Product-Led Growth (PLG) tactics, scalable growth loops, and rigorous experimentation to uncover and amplify the highest-impact opportunities across the product ecosystem.
Our team unites exceptional talent across disciplines to execute rapid tests, conduct deep analytics, and foster cross-functional collaboration that drives both customer value and business performance.
As a **Staff Data Scientist,** you will operate as a senior individual contributor, partnering closely with peers and leaders to identify, validate, and refine innovative growth strategies. Your expertise—especially in causal inference and advanced analytics—will be instrumental in surfacing critical insights and translating them into actionable hypotheses that fuel sustained customer and revenue growth.
**Responsibilities**
**Set Technical Vision and Strategy:**
* Contribute to and help refine a data science roadmap aimed at driving product funnel optimization and scalable growth initiatives. * Apply rigorous causal inference methods, advanced statistical modeling, and machine learning techniques to turn complex data into actionable insights.
**Drive Deep Analytics & Experimentation:**
* Develop an integrated view of the customer journey across various business metrics, quickly familiarizing yourself with new areas to pinpoint growth opportunities. * Design, implement, and analyze targeted experiments to validate hypotheses, ensuring each initiative is built on data-driven insights and sound causal analysis.
**Collaborate Across Functions:**
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and other cross-functional teams to translate data insights into strategic product enhancements. * Support ongoing improvements in instrumentation, data quality, and logging practices to enrich our analytical capabilities and understanding of customer behavior.
**Lead by Example:**
* Serve as a technical SME within the Product Growth team, championing analytical rigor and innovative problem-solving approaches.
**Operate with Agility and Impact:**
* Rapidly assimilate diverse business metrics and data sources to uncover insights and propose high-impact hypotheses. * Balance rigorous technical analysis with swift, iterative execution to ensure that insights are quickly transformed into effective strategies.
**Qualifications**
**Experience & Expertise:**
* 5+ years of experience in data science or analytics, with a proven record of applying advanced analytical methods to drive product and business growth. * Demonstrated proficiency in causal inference techniques, statistical modeling, machine learning, and experimental design.
**Technical Proficiency:**
* Advanced skills in SQL, Python, R, and other analytical tools, with practical experience using data visualization platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to communicate insights. * Experience with data integration and pipeline development is a plus.
**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Leadership:**
* Strong ability to quickly understand new business areas, mastering the essential data and metrics needed for informed decision-making. * Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with a track record of effectively influencing both technical and non-technical stakeholders through data-driven insights.
**Mindset & Attributes:**
* A relentless focus on customer centricity, with deep empathy and a commitment to uncovering opportunities that improve customer experiences. * An agile, entrepreneurial mindset, capable of balancing long-term strategic initiatives with rapid, iterative experimentation.
Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.
The expected base pay range for this position is:
Mountain View $194,000 - $262,500

item.title: Data Scientist, Cloud Distribution & Growth - OpenAI
item.description:
Data Science - San Francisco and Seattle
**About the Team**
Cloud service providers give developers a way to use OpenAI models in the environments where they already build and run software. Our team works with Go-to-Market (GTM), Product, Engineering, and Finance to understand which customers we can reach through these providers and what helps them grow from a first API call to a production workload.
**About the Role**
In your first few months, you’ll identify a customer segment or workload where OpenAI can grow, recommend an investment to GTM, Product, and Engineering, and define how we’ll know whether it brought new usage to OpenAI. Your first priority will be to explain what drives usage and revenue across providers. You’ll use that understanding to help GTM decide which customers and workloads to invest in and to build forecasts the team can plan against.
A customer might sign a substantial cloud commitment and send very little traffic. You can sit down with the account team, trace the customer’s first requests, and work out whether they need help launching, access to a different model, or more capacity. When you see the same opportunity across customers, your work can change where OpenAI invests.
**In This Role, You Will:**
* Build a reliable view of the business from provider usage reports, billing records, and API logs. Show how new workloads, expansion, changes in price, and shifts in model mix contribute to growth. * Estimate how much demand cloud distribution adds to OpenAI. Trace customer activity across channels to distinguish new use cases from traffic that moved from the direct API. * Identify where customers are ready to scale. Combine what account teams hear with evidence on request failures, latency, and model availability. Work with Product and Engineering on a change and measure what happens to usage. * Shape growth plans with GTM and Finance. Estimate what existing workloads and upcoming launches can contribute by year end, test the assumptions that matter most, and recommend where to focus with each provider. * Own the consumption forecast. Compare forecasts with actual usage over the same period, explain the biggest misses, and use what you learn to improve the next forecast.
**You Might Thrive in This Role If You:**
* Like questions that take you from a conversation with an account team to a query about a single API request. You’re curious about why a customer’s behavior differs from what the numbers first suggest. * Are comfortable making a recommendation while some questions are still open. You can tell a sales leader where you’d invest and explain to an engineer what evidence would change your mind.
**Qualifications**
* Experience independently leading data science work on a product, growth, or commercial question that changed a business decision. * Strong SQL and Python skills. You can join incomplete datasets, choose the right unit of analysis, and validate an aggregate result against individual customers or workloads. * Experience using cohorts, experiments, or observational comparisons to assess what drove a change. You can explain how customer selection affects the conclusion and evaluate a forecast against a simple baseline.
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with API platforms, cloud marketplaces, enterprise GTM, or a usage-based business. * Experience connecting service reliability or capacity to customer adoption, or using demand forecasts to guide a commercial or infrastructure investment.
**About OpenAI**
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.
We are an equal opportunity employeration, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable lawation technology systems and related data security obligations.
To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities.
At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.
**Compensation**
$347K – $445K + Offers Equity
The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factorsance-related bonus(es) for eligible employees, and the following benefits.
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family, with employer contributions to Health Savings Accounts * Pre-tax accounts for Health FSA, Dependent Care FSA, and commuter expenses (parking and transit) * 401(k) retirement plan with employer match * Paid parental leave (up to 24 weeks for birth parents and 20 weeks for non-birthing parents), plus paid medical and caregiver leave (up to 8 weeks) * Paid time off: flexible PTO for exempt employees and up to 15 days annually for non-exempt employees * 13+ paid company holidays, and multiple paid coordinated company office closures throughout the year for focus and recharge, plus paid sick or safe time (1 hour per 30 hours worked, or more, as required by applicable state or local law) * Mental health and wellness support * Employer-paid basic life and disability coverage * Annual learning and development stipend to fuel your professional growth * Daily meals in our offices, and meal delivery credits as eligible * Relocation support for eligible employees * Additional taxable fringe benefits, such as charitable donation matching and wellness stipends, may also be provided.
More details about our benefits are available to candidates during the hiring process.
This role is at-will and OpenAI reserves the right to modify base pay and other compensation components at any time based on individual performance, team or company results, or market conditions.

item.title: AI Data Scientist Technical Leader (Hybrid) - Cisco
item.description:
**The application window is expected to close on:** 11/30/2026This is a hybrid role based thrice a week in Cisco's San Jose, CA office.
Meet The Team
We are seeking a highly skilled AI Data Scientist / Data Analyst to join our Silicon One Hardware Engineering team. In this role, you will leverage sophisticated analytics, machine learning, and AI agent technologies to drive yield analysis, debug, and predictive modeling for our semiconductor manufacturing processes. Your work will directly impact product quality, test cost, manufacturing efficiency, and time-to-market for Cisco’s industry-leading silicon solutions.
Your Impact
* Develop, deploy, and maintain AI/ML models for yield analysis, yield debug, and early-stage failure prediction in semiconductor manufacturing. * Build and optimize AI agents to automate data-driven root cause analysis and yield improvement initiatives. * Analyze large-scale manufacturing, test, and parametric datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and actionable insights. * Collaborate with hardware, test, and process engineering teams to translate business and technical requirements into robust data science solutions. * Design and implement predictive models to forecast yield and quality metrics at various stages of the manufacturing flow. * Communicate findings and recommendations to multi-functional teams through clear visualizations, reports, and presentations. * Stay current with the latest advancements in AI/ML, data analytics, and semiconductor manufacturing best practices. * Excellent problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.
Minimum Qualifications
* MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field. * 8+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or data analytics, preferably in semiconductor or hardware engineering environments. * Strong proficiency in Python and data science libraries (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch). * Experience building, validating, and deploying AI/ML models for classification, regression, anomaly detection, and time-series forecasting. * Hands-on experience with AI agent frameworks and automation of data analysis workflows. * Solid understanding of semiconductor manufacturing, test data, and yield analysis concepts. * Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., matplotlib, seaborn, Tableau, Power BI).
Preferred Qualifications
* Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) and big data technologies. * Familiarity with Optuna or other hyperparameter optimization frameworks. * Knowledge of hardware debug, root cause analysis, and reliability engineering.
Why Cisco?
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

item.title: Applied Scientist, AWS Agentic AI - Amazon Web Services
item.description:
**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
The best coding assistants have to do two hard things together: understand code as the structured, interconnected system it really is, and keep learning from every interaction so they get better over time. Most AI tools today do neither well. They flatten code into tokens and lose the structure that makes software navigable, and they start each session from scratch, forgetting what they learned yesterday about a developer's codebase, patterns, and way of working. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is assembling an elite team of scientists and engineers to change both at once, and we are hiring an Applied Scientist who will work across code understanding and continual learning as a single, connected problem. You will help create generative AI technologies, including Kiro IDE and CLI, that are transforming how software gets built.
In this role you will turn the many signals around code, from static analysis and symbol graphs to build systems and language servers, into a unified representation our models can reason over, and you will make that system learn over time, so it accumulates knowledge without forgetting what it already knew, retrieves the right memory at the right moment, and personalizes the experience for each developer and team. These are not two separate jobs. A system that understands code deeply is also the one best positioned to remember and personalize how it helps, and you will own that intersection end to end. Your work will reach millions of developers rather than sit in a paper.
Key job responsibilities
* Build representations of code that fuse static analysis, symbol and call graphs, type information, and build system context, and that models can use at repository scale
* Make those systems learn over time through memory-augmented architectures, retrieval mechanisms, and personalization that consolidate and recall knowledge across sessions
* Invent and implement state-of-the-art machine learning solutions that operate at unprecedented Amazon scale
* Deploy products that directly impact the daily workflows of millions of developers worldwide
* Publish and present your work at premier ML, NLP, and software engineering conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, ICSE, FSE)
* Accelerate innovation by working directly with customers to rapidly transition research breakthroughs into production systems
About the team Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Hybrid Work We value innovation and recognize this sometimes requires uninterrupted time to focus on a build. We also value in-person collaboration and time spent face-to-face. Our team affords employees options to work in the office every day or in a flexible, hybrid work model near one of our U.S. Amazon offices.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------
* 3+ years of building models for business application experience * PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience * Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals * Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language * Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ----------------------------
* Experience using Unix/Linux * Experience in professional software development
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.
Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. item.title: Applied Scientist, AWS Agentic AI - Amazon.com
item.description:
**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
Great code assistants have to understand code the way an experienced engineer does, not as a wall of text but as a living structure of symbols, calls, types, and dependencies that span an entire repository. Most AI tools today flatten all of that into tokens and lose the structure that makes real software navigable. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is assembling an elite team of scientists and engineers to fix that, and we are hiring an Applied Scientist to build the intelligence layer that lets our AI development tools reason about code through its true structure. item.title: Principal Applied Scientist, QEC SW, MQS Center for Quantum Computing - Amazon Web Services
item.description:
**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
The Models, Quantum, and Silicon (MQS) Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) is a multi-disciplinary team of scientists, engineers, and technicians, on a mission to develop a fault-tolerant quantum computer.
We are looking to hire a Principal Applied Scientist to join our growing Software team. You’ll work closely with our partners on the control hardware development and quantum error correction theory teams to build a quantum control system capable of supporting the next generation of fault-tolerant workloads This requires someone who (1) has a strong desire to work within a team of scientists and engineers, and (2) demonstrates ownership in initiating and driving projects to completion.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at Amazon, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Export Control Requirement
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be either a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be able to obtain a US export license. If you are unsure if you meet these requirements, please apply and Amazon will review your application for eligibility.
Key job responsibilities
* Contribute to the software/gateware runtime for our next-generation quantum control system * Build emulation tooling to enable exploring the requirements space of control systems for real-time quantum error detection and correction * Make opinionated decisions about engineering tradeoffs to inform our control hardware/software roadmap * Demonstrate thought leadership in FTQC by releasing open-source software and publishing research * Empower other scientists to actively contribute to the codebase through mentorship and documentation
We are looking for candidates with strong engineering principles, a bias for action, superior problem-solving, and excellent communication skills. Working effectively within a team environment is essential.
A day in the life The majority of your time will be spent on projects that extend the functional capabilities or performance of our internal control stack. This requires working backwards from the needs of our science staff in the context of our larger experimental roadmap. You will translate science and software requirements into design proposals balancing implementation complexity against time-to-delivery. Once a design proposal has been reviewed and accepted, you’ll drive implementation and coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure a smooth roll out. Because many high-level experimental goals have cross-cutting requirements, you’ll often work closely with other engineers or scientists or on the team.
About the team You will be joining the Software group within the MQS Center of Quantum Computing. Our team is comprised of scientists and software engineers who are building scalable software that enables quantum computing technologies.

* PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field * Experience distilling informal customer requirements into problem definitions, dealing with ambiguity and competing objectives * Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language * Experience with leading experienced scientists as well as having a record of developing junior members from academia or industry to a career track in a business environment * Experience working with scientists in a research environment * Experience with quantum error correction and quantum control systems

item.title: Staff Data Scientist - Intuit
item.description:
**Overview** ------------
Mailchimp is a leading marketing automation platform that empowers millions of businesses to grow through powerful, easy-to-use marketing and messaging solutions. As we expand beyond email into omnichannel customer engagement, Messaging is at the forefront of Mailchimp's growth strategy, helping businesses connect with their customers through SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, and other emerging communication channels.
Come join the **Mailchimp Product Data Science team as a Staff Data Scientist supporting Messaging**, one of our most exciting and strategically important growth areas. We are looking for a creative, business-minded problem solver who is passionate about leveraging data science to unlock customer value, accelerate product innovation, and drive measurable business impact.
As a **Staff Data Scientist,** you will serve as a **senior individual contributor and strategic thought partner** to Product, Engineering, Design, Finance, and Product Marketing leaders. You will tackle complex, high-impact business problems across the messaging customer journey—from adoption and engagement to monetization, retention, and revenue growth. Your expertise in advanced analytics, experimentation, causal inference, machine learning, and automation will be instrumental in identifying growth opportunities, shaping product strategy, and influencing investment decisions.
This role offers a unique opportunity to help shape the future of Mailchimp's omnichannel messaging strategy. You will lead strategic research, develop scalable data products and measurement frameworks, and translate complex insights into actionable recommendations that influence product roadmaps and accelerate business outcomes. Beyond individual projects, you will help elevate data science capabilities across teams, break down organizational silos, and establish analytical approaches that scale across the broader Mailchimp ecosystem.
**Responsibilities**
* **Strategic Data Partnership & Influence:** Serve as a trusted data science partner to Product, Engineering, Design, Finance, and Product Marketing leaders, shaping Mailchimp's omnichannel messaging strategy across SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, and emerging channels. Influence product roadmaps, investment priorities, and business decisions through data-driven insights. * **Product Strategy & Revenue Growth:** Identify, size, and prioritize high-impact growth opportunities across the messaging customer journey, including acquisition, adoption, activation, engagement, monetization, and retention. Translate ambiguous business challenges into rigorous analytical frameworks and actionable recommendations that accelerate customer and revenue growth. * **Advanced Analytics & Causal Inference:** Lead complex, end-to-end analytical investigations using advanced statistics, SQL, Python, machine learning, and causal inference. Design and evaluate A/B tests and quasi-experiments (e.g., difference-in-differences, matching, synthetic control) to establish causal relationships, quantify incremental impact, and guide product decisions. * **Measurement Strategy & Experimentation:** Develop scalable measurement frameworks and define success metrics to evaluate messaging product performance, customer outcomes, and business impact. Champion experimentation best practices and analytical rigor to enable faster, more confident decision-making. * **Scalable Data Products & AI Innovation:** Build reusable analytical frameworks, automated insights, opportunity-sizing tools, and self-service data products that democratize access to insights and scale Data Science impact. Leverage modern AI/ML techniques and AI-assisted tools to accelerate analytical workflows and improve organizational productivity. * **Predictive Modeling & Customer Intelligence:** Apply machine learning, predictive modeling, and customer segmentation to uncover behavioral patterns, identify growth opportunities, and optimize messaging adoption, engagement, and customer lifetime value. * **Data Quality & Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Data Engineering and platform teams to improve data instrumentation, quality, reliability, and accessibility. Break down organizational silos by developing consistent metrics, sharing learnings, and scaling analytical solutions across messaging channels and the broader Mailchimp ecosystem. * **Executive Communication & Technical Leadership:** Translate complex analytical findings into compelling, actionable narratives for technical and nontechnical stakeholders, including senior leadership. Provide technical thought leadership, mentor peers, and elevate the organization's standards for data-driven decision-making, experimentation, and innovation.
**Qualifications**
* **8+ years of experience** in Data Science, Product Analytics, or a related quantitative discipline, with a demonstrated track record of driving measurable customer, product, and revenue impact in SaaS, marketing technology, or digital products. * **Deep expertise in advanced analytics, experimentation, and causal inference**, including A/B testing and quasi-experimental methods (e.g., difference-in-differences, matching, synthetic control, regression discontinuity). Demonstrated ability to select and apply rigorous methodologies to ambiguous business problems and quantify incremental impact. * **Strong foundation in predictive modeling and machine learning**, including customer segmentation, propensity modeling, churn prediction, with experience translating models and insights into actionable product and business decisions. * **Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python** (e.g., pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels), with hands-on experience analyzing large, complex datasets, developing statistical models, and building scalable analytical solutions. * **Strong product and business acumen**, with experience identifying and sizing growth opportunities, evaluating product performance, and influencing strategies related to customer acquisition, adoption, engagement, monetization, and retention. * **Experience building scalable data products and analytical frameworks**, including automated insights, opportunity-sizing tools, and self-service solutions that improve decision-making and extend Data Science impact beyond individual analyses. * **Working fluency with modern AI tools and workflows**, including LLM-based coding assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude) and AI-assisted analytics, with the ability to accelerate analytical development while maintaining high standards for accuracy, reproducibility, and rigor. * **Proven ability to navigate ambiguity and influence cross-functional stakeholders**, independently leading complex analytical initiatives and translating insights into strategic recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes. * **Exceptional communication and data storytelling skills**, with demonstrated ability to influence senior leadership, communicate complex technical concepts clearly, and drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Design, Finance, and Marketing. * **Bachelor's degree** in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field; advanced degree preferred.
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in **messaging, marketing automation, communications platforms, or omnichannel customer engagement**, including SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, or email marketing. * Experience with **SaaS monetization, usage-based pricing, product-led growth, and customer lifecycle optimization**. * Demonstrated technical leadership through mentoring, establishing analytical best practices, and scaling data science capabilities across teams.

item.title: Principal Applied Scientist, Real-Time Conversational AI , AGI - Amazon.com
item.description:
**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
We are looking for a Principal Applied Scientist to drive the research and development of real-time multimodal conversational AI. You will operate across two focus areas: advancing foundation models for speech and audio, and building the post-training systems (reward modeling, reinforcement learning) that shape natural, human-like conversational behavior.
You will be the expert in your area while contributing across the full model lifecycle — from pre-training and architecture design through post-training alignment and real-time deployment. You will work at the frontier of what's possible in conversational AI, with the compute, data, and runway to pursue problems that few teams in the world have the resources to tackle.
As a Principal Scientist, you will set the technical direction for your research area, influence the broader roadmap, and work closely with inference engineers to ensure your models are designed for real-time production deployment from inception.
Key job responsibilities Foundation Model Scaling
* Build and train large-scale multimodal foundation models for real-time speech and audio generation, from architecture design through production-scale training
* Advance the scaling and efficiency of conversational modes, including the relationship between data, model size, and real time performance.
* Design model architectures informed by hardware constraints and inference requirements, working with inference engineers to ensure models are servable from inception
* Develop training methodologies for multimodal models that jointly process and generate speech, language, and audio in real-time streaming contexts
Post-Training & Reinforcement Learning
* Design and build reward models and reward functions for speech systems — capturing naturalness, fluency, conversational quality, and real-time responsiveness
* Develop and apply reinforcement learning methods to shape conversational behavior — teaching models natural timing, responsiveness, and fluid interaction
* Build the post-training pipeline from SFT through RL alignment, optimized for real-time multimodal outputs rather than text-only generation
* Design evaluation frameworks that capture the quality dimensions unique to real-time conversation
Real-Time Perception & Generation
* Advance the team's capabilities in real-time perception
* Work at the intersection of model architecture and production constraints to ensure multimodal capabilities function within hard real-time latency budgets
About the team We are a small, focused group of scientists and engineers building the next generation of real-time conversational AI at Amazon — models that interact naturally across speech and audio. We operate with the autonomy and pace of a research lab, backed by frontier-scale compute and a multi-year investment horizon.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------
* Experience distilling informal customer requirements into problem definitions, dealing with ambiguity and competing objectives * PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, Speech/Audio Processing, or equivalent quantitative field * 10+ years of applied research experience (industry or combined academic + industry) * Demonstrated experience training large-scale foundation models — hands-on involvement in scaling exercises, not just using pre-trained models * Experience with multimodal model architectures that jointly process or generate across speech, text, and audio modalities * Strong understanding of transformer architectures and their application to speech/audio domains * Publication record at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, Interspeech, ICASSP, ACL, or equivalent) * Demonstrated Principal/Staff+ scientific leadership — setting research direction, mentoring researchers, influencing multi-team decisions
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ----------------------------
* 10+ years of relevant work in industry or academia experience * Hands-on experience building real-time AI systems — speech, audio, or video * Track record with post-training methods: reinforcement learning, reward modeling, RLHF/RLAIF, or alignment techniques applied to generative models * Experience with real-time interactive systems — models that handle concurrent input and output * Experience building speech-to-speech or audio-to-audio generative models (codec models, autoregressive audio generation) * Hands-on design of reward models or reward functions specifically for speech/audio quality, naturalness, or conversational behavior * Experience with distributed training at scale — including parallelism strategies, training stability, and curriculum design * Familiarity with hardware-informed model design — understanding how architecture choices affect inference latency, memory, and cost * Background in speech recognition, speech synthesis (TTS), or speech enhancement * Experience shipping research to production at scale — models serving real users, not just benchmark results * Contributions to open-source speech/audio ML systems or widely used research codebases * History of mentoring and growing research teams from individual contributors to technical leaders

The FAIM (Full Funnel Agentic Intelligence and Models) builds the agentic AI systems behind next-generation advertising. The team develops multimodal foundation models and LLM-driven agents that power shopper understanding, audience-aware creative generation, and agentic advertising workflows.
As a Principal Applied Scientist for the FAIM team, you will invent the models that help advertisers achieve desired outcomes. Today's state of the art models can setup ad campaigns to a specification, but do not understand advertising strategy well enough to help with abstract goals that real advertisers ask about like "how can I make more money."
This is a rare charter to build foundational optimization science where little exists today, spanning campaign recommendation, cross-product budget allocation, incrementality measurement, and long-term-sales modeling. item.title: Applied Scientist, Center for Quantum Computing - Amazon Web Services
item.description:
**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
Amazon’s Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) is building the next generation of quantum computing hardware.
The Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) is our longest-horizon bet and operates at the intersection of hardware and physics. The goal is a quantum computer that could solve in hours what today's most robust machines would take thousands of years to compute, unlocking breakthroughs in myriad of areas ranging from advanced materials for batteries to cryptography and fundamentally-secure data sharing protocols. This program involves R&D in device theory, materials science, nano-scale fabrication, superconducting circuit design, cryogenic refrigeration, and quantum algorithms and applications.
Currently, the quantum hardware team is focused on improving the underlying chip fabrication of the quantum processor and the scaling of the control system needed to run large-scale quantum circuits. As part of this effort, the team is expanding its chip fabrication capabilities through the construction of a new cleanroom facility dedicated to superconducting quantum chip fabrication, and working with strategic partners to develop scaled versions of the control electronics, I/O wiring, and cryogenic refrigeratation needed for utility-scale quantum computers.
We operate with a startup-like pace inside one of the world's most capable technology organizations, combining the urgency of a competitive frontier with the resources and infrastructure of pan Amazon.
We are seeking an Applied Scientist III to join our team and drive the design, construction, and operation of quantum processors. You will work alongside world-class physicists and engineers to push the frontier of quantum computing — from laser system design and atom trapping to high-fidelity gate execution and quantum error correction. This is a rare opportunity to be part of shaping a technology that could define the next era of computing.
Key job responsibilities
* Design, build, and operate quantum computing experiments, including optical trapping arrays, laser cooling and state-preparation systems, and high-fidelity gate-driving optics
* Develop and optimize two-qubit entangling gates using interactions, targeting fidelities at or beyond the current state of the art (>99.5%)
* Implement and characterize erasure-detection protocols leveraging the metastable-state structure of ¹⁷¹Yb to achieve hardware-native erasure conversion rates >90%
* Contribute to quantum error correction experiments, including surface codes and quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes, and work toward demonstrating error suppression factors (Λ) well beyond current published records
* Design and improve atom-array loading, rearrangement, and continuous replenishment techniques to support registers of thousands to tens of thousands of atoms
* Develop control software and calibration routines for high-speed experimental sequences, including real-time feedback and adaptive protocols
* Analyze experimental data, build physical models to explain observed behavior, and propose and execute improvements to system performance
* Collaborate with theory, software, and hardware engineering teams to co-design quantum architectures, error-correcting codes, and decoder systems
* Publish results in leading scientific journals and present at top conferences to maintain Amazon's visibility in the quantum research community
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------
* 3+ years of building models for business application experience * Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals * Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language * Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ----------------------------
* Experience using Unix/Linux * Experience in professional software development

item.title: Sr. Data Scientist, Performance Marketing - Pinterest
item.description:
**About Pinterest:**
Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we're on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other's unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It's Possible.
At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we're looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we'll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our marketing org. As a Senior Data Scientist you introduce greater scientific rigor into the marketing measurement and optimization processes to shape Pinterest's user growth and marketing strategy. The results of your work will influence and drive strategic decisions for the company - identify investment opportunities for growth, understand user growth and behavior, and define metrics to grow and sustain our user base. You will collaborate on a wide array of business problems with a diverse set of cross-functional partners across Marketing, Product, Engineering, Design, Research, Product Analytics, Data Engineering and others.
The role is within the Growth Marketing team, and would be supporting performance marketing efforts focused on driving user growth for Pinterest.
**What you'll do:**
* Deep strategic analysis to answer growth marketing ecosystem questions such as how to drive monthly active users from paid performance marketing, how to quantify the effect of paid performance marketing in new markets, how to drive user engagement and user LTV (lifetime value) from performance marketing. * Evolve our existing systems like geo-testing frameworks and other incrementality testing frameworks. * Build and deploy statistical and machine learning models such as propensity, forecasting, and lifetime value (LTV) models—to optimize marketing strategies and enhance audience targeting. * Develop new statistical models as well as maintain/improve existing models like user lifetime value models, budgeting models, long term user retention models etc. * Collaborate on a wide array of product and business problems with a diverse set of cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Analytics, Marketing, Data Engineering and others.
**Evolve our experimentation capabilities and tools to evaluate the business impact of performance marketing investment. Advise on experimentation best practices; identifying flaws in experiment practices and results; building tools for experiment analysis; etc.** **Identify the right measures of success for teams and help them track those metrics. Own the full lifecycle of those metrics from logging requirements, metrics definition, prototype pipelines, and improvements.**
* Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insights and strategic recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership. * Write clear, actionable analyses that help teams uncover opportunities and identify areas of improvement to our existing strategies. * Design, maintain, and promote dashboards and automated reporting tools to empower stakeholders with self-serve, data-driven decision-making capabilities. Build and optimize ETL data pipelines to automate reporting, support deep dive analysis and feature engineering for analytical models.
**What we're looking for:**
* Minimum 5 years of combined post-graduate academic and industry experience applying scientific methods to solve real-world problems. * Master's degree in a quantitative field such as mathematics, statistics, computer science or engineering. * Hands-on experiences with building marketing measurement solutions to quantify the business impact of marketing tactics and investments. * Strong background in statistics and quantitative analysis, with experience in applying advanced statistical techniques to real-world problems. * Expertise in at least one scripting language (ideally Python/R). * Proficiency in SQL/Hive. Ability to write efficient SQL queries. * Strong business and product sense. Strong skills in shaping vague questions into well-defined analyses and success metrics that drive business decisions. * Excellent communication skills, able to lead initiatives and communicate findings to the leadership and cross-functional teams. Explains work and thought processes clearly and concisely. * Experience leading key technical projects. * Strong Experimentation background. * Statistical rigor. Experience with causal inference projects.

You will advise CIOs, CTOs, CDOs and business executives, govern the decisions made by architecture teams, and make sure that what we propose is what we can deliver: secure, scalable, cost-effective and tied to measurable business outcomes.

item.title: Software Engineer, Audio Applied Scientist - Meta
item.description:
We are the teams who create all of Meta's products used by billions of people around the world. Want to build new features and improve existing products like Messenger, Video, Groups, News Feed, Search, AR/VR, GenAI and more? Want to solve unique, large scale, highly complex technical problems? Meta is seeking experienced Audio Applied Scientists to join our teams. You can help build the technologies that help us connect the next billion people, create new features that have billions of interactions per day and be a part of a team that’s working to help people connect with each other around the globe. As an Audio Applied Scientist at Meta, you can help build new, innovative technologies and software that improve the way people work, play, and connect and especially how they hear the virtual and augmented world or interact with GenAI bots. What we build today could one day be the norm. So to be here today is to be part of a team shaping new products and technologies. We may not have all the answers. But together, we're getting closer.
### **Software Engineer, Audio Applied Scientist Responsibilities:**
* Research, design, and develop advanced signal processing algorithms with application to speech and audio * Define and build new algorithms and add enhancements to existing algorithms to support human listening, machine listening, and other new experiences for communications * Build specialized Machine Learning (ML) for resource constrained platforms (e.g., mobile/wearables). Explore new paradigms in AI and Machine Learning * Hands-on implementation and optimization of algorithms for classical DSP and ML inference engines * Contribute to roadmap planning for the next generation of platforms * Collaborate with other researchers/scientists, engineers, cross-functional partners from multiple disciplines
### **Minimum Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience * Solid understanding in fundamentals of Digital Signal Processing (DSP) and Machine Learning (ML) * 5+ years of software development experience in audio, signal processing, or related technical domains * 3+ years relevant audio software engineering experience including DSP/ML audio algorithm development in industry settings * Demonstrated communication skills and experience working across disciplines to drive optimal solutions and supporting cross functional teams * Experience with C or C++ and with scientific programming languages such as MATLAB, Python or similar * Experience in any of the following areas: Small footprint ML, Differential DSP, Echo/Noise reduction, Spatial Processing, Hearing Aids * Must obtain work authorization in the country of employment at the time of hire, and maintain ongoing work authorization during employment
### **Preferred Qualifications:**
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) * Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies * MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent * Proven track record of innovation as demonstrated by products shipped, publications and/or patents * Expertise in audio signal processing both classical and machine learning techniques * Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements) * Experience developing GenAI systems * Experience communicating technical concepts to peers, partners, and non-technical stakeholders through written and verbal channels (e.g., design docs, presentations, cross-functional reviews)
### **About Meta:**
Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.
Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. item.title: Machine Learning Engineer - University of California - San Francisco
item.description:
This is a grant funded, 18 month, Limited Appointment position.
Certain terms and conditions of employment for this position, including the rate of pay, benefits, etc., are currently subject to negotiation with the appropriate union.
This position is considered flexible, 2 days on-site, and must be available for lab on-site meetings that may happen once per week or bi-weekly, based on needs of the department.
The Machine Learning and Data engineer role will lead the development, implementation, and maintenance of data pipelines and infrastructure to support the deployment and continuous monitoring of Machine Learning (ML) and generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools within UCSF’s APeX Enabled Research (AER) team. Most projects will be in partnership with other UCSF technical teams and involve highly customized research solutions. Communication skills and inventive technical solutioning are crucial.
The AER team provides a large array of services to the UCSF Research community, including project consultation, grant support, budget estimations, and project implementation and support. Project examples include:
* Development of EHR-based interventions via clinical trials embedded within healthcare delivery systems to generate scientific evidence while delivering healthcare.
+ Enabling UCSF researchers with algorithms, digital tools and / or clinical interventions with strong evidence of feasibility and acceptability. + Develop technical approaches and budgets in order to implement these tools within the electronic medical record. + Supporting the development of scalable, low cost infrastructure to enable ongoing research.
This role primarily involves managing and optimizing the data and monitoring pipelines of the Health IT Platform for Advanced Computing (HIPAC), a cloud infrastructure that supports the development and deployment of AI/ML tools, including large language models (LLMs) in the EHR. Specifically, the ML/data engineer will work on implementing new data integrations, enhancing HIPAC’s ETL functionalities, productionizing AI/ML tools developed by UCSF data scientists/researchers, and designing and implementing metrics to continuously monitor AI/ML tools deployed at UCSF Health.
Competitive applicants for this position are software, machine learning, or data engineers with 6+ years of experience in implementing and maintaining AI/ML pipelines. Proficiency in MLOps, Python, SQL, and CI/CD is required. This role also requires a deep understanding of Epic data models (Clarity and Caboodle). Successful candidates either have or are able to obtain Epic Clinical/Clarity data model certification shortly after onboarding.
**Department Overview**
The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) Department of Information Technology Academic Research Systems (ARS) group is chartered to provide data services and infrastructure that support the UCSF Research Community’s computing and analytic requirements through centralized informatics services in the areas of Data, Tools, Secure Compute Environments, and Consulting Services.
**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related area and / or equivalent experience / training. * 6 years of experience in positions of increasing responsibility designing, implementing, and maintaining complex AI/ML applications. * Experience with data analysis and machine learning tools such as Jupyter, Pandas, scikit-learn, Numpy/Scipy, PyTorch, etc. * Demonstrated advanced knowledge of full software development lifecycle * Advanced experience with Python; ability to write clean, efficient, and production-level Python code * Advanced experience with SQL (e.g., SQLServer, PostgreSQL) * Demonstrated experience deploying, monitoring, and maintaining AI/ML models and pipelines * Advanced experience in database systems, data warehousing solutions, and understanding of ETL pipelines * Advanced experience in designing, building, or maintaining data infrastructure for efficient ML model training and inference. * Demonstrated experience working with MLOps, DevOps, and CI/CD pipeline toolsets * Experience in developing complex, automated testing * Experience with cloud-based architecture in platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure * Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills * Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information to technical and non-technical personnel at various levels in the organization * Self-motivated and works independently and as part of a team. Able to learn effectively and meet deadlines * Demonstrated broad problem-solving skills * Demonstrated ability to interface with management on a regular basis * Excellent project leadership and management skills.
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
* Master’s Degree or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related area and / or equivalent experience / training. * Experience with large language models and other generative AI technologies, especially supporting the deployment of GenAI-based tools in a production environment * Familiar with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau) * Experience with Epic data structures * Epic Clarity Certification * Cloud Development certifications
**About UCSF**
The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is a leading university dedicated to promoting health worldwide through advanced biomedical research, graduate-level education in the life sciences and health professions, and excellence in patient care. It is the only campus in the 10-campus UC system dedicated exclusively to the health sciences. We bring together the world’s leading experts in nearly every area of health. We are home to five Nobel laureates who have advanced the understanding of cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, aging and stem cells.
**Pride Values**
UCSF is a diverse community made of people with many skills and talents. We seek candidates whose work experience or community service has prepared them to contribute to our commitment to professionalism, respect, integrity, diversity and excellence – also known as our PRIDE values .
In addition to our PRIDE values, UCSF is committed to equity – both in how we deliver care as well as our workforce. We are committed to building a broadly diverse community, nurturing a culture that is welcoming and supportive, and engaging diverse ideas for the provision of culturally competent education, discovery, and patient care. Additional information about UCSF is available here .
Join us to find a rewarding career contributing to improving healthcare worldwide.
**Equal Employment Opportunity**
The University of California is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, or other protected status under state or federal law.
**Salary Information**
The final salary and offer components are subject to additional approvals based on UC policy.
Your placement within the salary range is dependent on a number of factors including your work experience and internal equity within this position classification at UCSF. For positions that are represented by a labor union, placement within the salary range will be guided by the rules in the collective bargaining agreement.

item.description:

The Senior Machine Learning Engineer will lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable machine learning solutions that address complex business challenges, with a primary focus on building auto-research capabilities that automate model training optimization, experimentation, and evaluation to accelerate the ML development lifecycle. item.title: Senior Data Scientist - Customer Success - Intuit
item.description:
**Overview** ------------
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Sr. Data Scientist to join our Customer Success Data Science team. In this role, you'll drive data-driven strategies to optimize Customer Success outcomes across our Accountants and Partner business, supporting the professionals and firms who serve small and mid-market businesses on Intuit's platform. You will frame the right question before the analysis runs and drive the evidence through to the decision that changes the business, owning the causal identification that isolates what actually moves outcomes. If you're passionate about shaping the future of customer success through data, we'd love to hear from you!
**Responsibilities**
* **Define KPIs and Success Metrics:** Frame the right question before any analysis runs and establish the business metrics and causal levers the business manages to, such as onboarding and time-to-value, product adoption, customer health, retention, and growth, ensuring they are measured consistently across reporting surfaces and leadership reviews. * **Strategic Recommendations:** Provide actionable recommendations using diverse data sets and business knowledge, even when complete data is unavailable, including a clear ship-or-iterate call when the model is imperfect. * **Experimentation and Causal Inference:** Own the inference approach end to end. Choose and defend the method, whether a randomized experiment, a quasi-experiment, or a predictive model, and isolate what actually moved a metric, including for service and coverage investments where clean randomization is not feasible. * **Predictive Analytics and Modeling:** Build and own predictive models such as customer health scoring, churn and expansion propensity, and next best action through their lifecycle, accountable for the outcomes they drive and not only their accuracy. * **Segmentation:** Build and apply durable customer segmentation patterns to refine targeting, positioning, service coverage, and customer experience. * **Data Visualizations and Storytelling:** Translate complex data into clear, accessible visualizations and author the executive-level communication that helps leaders understand the insight and act on it. * **Enable Self-Serve Analytics:** Design, build, and run team data products that are automated, monitored, and reliable enough that the business reviews them each week without rebuilding them by hand. Work with Data Engineering to ensure data quality and enhance real-time analytic capabilities. * **AI Integration:** Collaborate with AI teams to integrate AI solutions into business processes, size AI use cases against business value, and automate recurring analytical bottlenecks into agentic systems, owning the agent context so they inherit the team's rigor. * **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with product, digital, customer support, sales, and marketing teams to identify opportunities, create data-driven strategies, and influence decision-making.
**Qualifications**
* 4+ years of experience working with product analytics, web analytics, customer care analytics, or other customer experience analytics, preferably in fintech * Advanced proficiency in SQL, "big data" technologies (e.g., Redshift, Spark, Hive, BigQuery), and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Qlik, Plotly Dash) * Deep expertise in experimentation design (A/B/n, bandits) and causal inference (Propensity Score, DiD, Synthetic Control) with a strategic understanding of their application, including on small-sample or non-randomized populations where clean control groups are hard to construct * A track record of framing the question rather than only answering it: taking an ambiguous business problem through to a decision a team acted on * Experience building and owning predictive models through their lifecycle, with accountability for the business outcomes they drive * Experience building and maintaining data products that are automated, monitored, and reproducible rather than one-off analyses; directing AI tools to build and review that work is a plus * Strong business acumen and the ability to translate business strategy into testable hypotheses and learning agendas * Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to rapidly construct impactful visualization, communicate insights and influence leadership * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to build trust and collaborate seamlessly across technical, business, and cross-functional teams * Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and have flexibility to shift priorities when needed * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics or related quantitative field; Master's Degree preferred * Preferred: * + Strong programming skills in Python or R; experience building ML and GenAI models, including automation and custom implementations + Experience evaluating AI-native or non-deterministic systems, including defining what "good" means when outputs vary + Familiarity with the accounting, bookkeeping, or professional services domain, or an adjacent space such as tax + Experience solving growth-related problems at financial technology companies serving consumer or SMBs
Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). item.title: Data Scientist - Apple
item.description:
Do you want to decide whether a generative imaging feature is good enough to ship? Our team evaluates generative image and video features. These features reach a very large number of people on Apple devices. You will build the evaluation systems, human-annotation programs, and automated metrics that turn "this looks better" into measurable, trustworthy quality signals. Those signals guide model development and release decisions.
**Description**
You'll own quality evaluation end to end - from evaluation set design through annotation, scoring, analysis, and the recommendations that shape what engineering and product build next. Your findings determine which models ship.
What you'll do
Build the measurement foundation. Design and maintain golden sets and evaluation sets, analyzing data distributions so results stay representative and known defects stay covered.
Run human evaluation at quality. Write and iterate annotation guidelines and label schemas, build or adapt lightweight labeling tools for image and video review, monitor annotator quality, and resolve disagreements and guideline ambiguity.
Automate the repeatable parts. Develop automated metrics and LLM-as-judge systems, calibrate them against human labels, and track where they diverge.
Make the results decision-ready. Report model-vs-model comparisons with confidence intervals, significance testing, and breakdowns by hotspot, content type, and failure mode - then turn them into root-cause findings and prioritized recommendations.
Set the bar with your partners. Work with ML, engineering, and design to define quality standards, and communicate results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience evaluating 3D Gaussian splats or diffusion models, or assessing perceptual quality.
Experience building LLM or VLM judges and validating them against human ratings.
Experience building web-based labeling or review tools.
Ability to run several work-streams in parallel and prioritize them.
Proven cross-functional collaboration and the ability to learn new tools quickly.
Strong written and verbal communication, including explaining statistical tradeoffs to engineers and product partners.
**Minimum Qualifications**
MS and a minimum of 5 years relevant industry experience
5+ years of experience in data science, machine learning evaluation, algorithm analysis, or related technical disciplines.
Experience designing and analyzing evaluations and experiments, especially for ML or generative model quality. This includes sampling design, significance testing, and confidence intervals.
Strong Python skills and comfort with SQL, with the ability to build and maintain evaluation pipelines and small tools.
Familiarity with AI-assisted analysis workflows, foundation models, agentic systems, or intelligent automation approaches for technical problem solving.
**Pay & Benefits**
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $184,700 and $324,800, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

item.title: Principal Data Scientist, Capabilities & Acceleration - Intuit
item.description:
**Overview** ------------
The Global Business Solutions Group (GBSG) Data Science organization is building a central capability team dedicated to how Data Scientists across the org build, ship, and scale their work.
The DS Capabilities & Acceleration Team identifies the highest-leverage capabilities needed to accelerate data science at GBSG, builds them with rigor, and drives adoption across domain teams. As a Principal Data Scientist on this team, you will operate as a senior individual contributor at the intersection of data science, data architecture, and applied AI. You will build the data foundations and AI-native capabilities that the rest of the organization builds on, and you will prove they work by using them to ship real products yourself.
**Responsibilities**
**Build AI-Native Data Products:**
* Design and ship production-grade capabilities that combine data engineering, applied AI, and analytical judgment, moving from prototype to durable system rather than stopping at proof of concept. * Serve as the first builder on shared capabilities, validating architectural decisions through real implementations and feeding requirements back into the platform.
**Architect Data Foundations:**
* Design the data architecture, semantic grounding, and pipelines that AI and analytical workloads depend on, ensuring correctness and reuse are properties of the system rather than of individual diligence. * Establish patterns for how governed metric definitions, data quality, and freshness guarantees flow into downstream products and agentic workflows.
**Raise the Engineering Bar for Data Science:**
* Define and demonstrate what production-grade looks like for data science work: testing, observability, cost awareness, and graceful failure. * Partner with domain data science teams to turn one-off solutions into reusable, discoverable assets the broader organization can adopt with minimal effort.
**Lead Through Craft:**
* Serve as a technical leader and force multiplier across the GBSG Data Science organization, setting direction that others follow through demonstrated work rather than mandate. * Mentor data scientists on engineering practice, AI-native development, and data architecture, raising the collective capability of the org.
**Operate with Agility and Impact:**
* Rapidly assess where the organization is duplicating effort or blocked by missing foundations, and prioritize the capabilities with the broadest leverage. * Balance durable architecture with fast iteration, shipping usable increments rather than waiting on complete platforms.
**Qualifications**
**Experience & Expertise:**
* 10+ years of experience across data science, data engineering, or applied machine learning, with a proven record of shipping production systems rather than analyses alone. * Demonstrated depth in data architecture and modeling, with direct experience building the data foundations that analytical and AI products depend on. * Hands-on experience building with modern AI tooling, including LLM-based applications, agentic workflows, and evaluation practices.
**Technical Proficiency:**
* Advanced skills in SQL and Python, with strong software engineering fundamentals including version control, testing, code review, and CI/CD. * Practical experience with distributed data processing and warehouse platforms (e.g., Spark, Databricks), pipeline orchestration, and production deployment patterns. * Familiarity with semantic layers, metric governance, or metadata systems is a strong plus.
**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Leadership:**
* Strong ability to partner with data scientists as your primary customer, understanding their workflows deeply enough to build capabilities they actually adopt. * Excellent communication skills, with a track record of influencing technical direction across teams you do not manage.
**Mindset & Attributes:**
* Genuine enthusiasm for building with AI, paired with the discipline to ensure what gets built rests on solid data foundations. * A bias toward adoption: measures success by what other teams ship using your work, not by what you ship alone. * An entrepreneurial mindset suited to a new team, comfortable operating with ambiguity and defining the path as much as walking it.
